title: A PR that touches no macOS path starts zero macOS runners: gate the three macOS jobs at job level on scope, and let all-jobs-passed accept a scope-skip
why: Consultant 03:19 CST Nov 14 and coordinator 03:21 (relayed; the coordinator read checks.yml; unchecked by triage): the jobs shell-macos, checks-macos and checks-macos-b have a job `if` of only `github.event_name != 'push'`; the file's own comment says a step-level skip still starts the runner (R61). #3376 waited 52 min in the macOS queue and ran 24 min (n=1, relayed; step ci-wall-time). Sighting 03:28 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:27, from the #3005 lane's read of the file; unchecked by triage): `.github/scripts/ci-scope.sh` line 44 still maps edits to lint/check_unknown_reads_contract.py to the Windows, macOS and guard job flags, so after #3005 an edit to that file starts jobs that no longer run it. Triage pick: the cause is the #3005 change, so the home is step unknown-reads-lint-linux-only (its lane drops the mapping from ci-scope.sh in the same PR, or says why not, and a test proves an edit to that file sets no Windows or macOS flag); step macos-jobs-gated-by-scope reads the same file and takes the corrected flags. No new step. Update 04:40 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:40, relayed; unchecked by triage): draft PR #3398, head ab10b5c1652a (04:30), has a record at that head, comment 6876050316: fresh round 1, haiku, FAIL; no safety hole. Findings: a stale comment at checks.yml:1133, test-file wording and names, and a no-op helper planned_mac_push_guard. The lane is fixing, then pushes and posts a fix check. Not ready for runner 10 until then. Follow-ups the lane names and left out of #3398: the Windows legs, checks-mutate, the child repos' jobs, and the push-skip remote-form read. Update 04:48 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:47, relayed): #3398 is red on lint/check_red_run.py: two pushed commits add test lines with no Red-run trailer (8bd2edd4c, a2581769d). The check's remedy is a new branch and a replacement PR; the coordinator picked the replacement PR, which drops this PR's records and rounds (a second run of rounds 1-3). Whether a2581769d adds any new test line (a rename only would be a false alarm) is unmeasured; see red-run-pre-push. Update 05:00 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:00, relayed; unchecked by triage): the replacement draft is PR #3399, head abeb4e7a6 (coordinator's ls-remote read). Round 1, haiku: FAIL (no test pins that push-skip refuses a failed, cancelled or in-progress named macOS job; record comment 6876253216). A test-author adds the cases. Answer to the open question: commit a2581769d only renames test names and comments and adds no new test claim (the lane's statement; the coordinator did not diff it). HANDED IN 05:11 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:12, relayed; not re-read by triage): PR #3399 head cdf1982f1a56 (coordinator's ls-remote 05:10). Record comment 6876389535: round 1 haiku FAIL, fix check sonnet PASS at abeb4e7a6, net value not owed. The lane says no round 3, because a fix check PASS ends its round (owner item 741). Follow-ups the lane lists for the roadmap: the Windows legs, checks-mutate, the child repos' jobs, the push-skip remote-form read, and a no-op helper `planned_nightly_skip` (debt notes in docs/debts/notes.md). Triage filed no new step for them: they are the lane's list on this step until the coordinator asks for steps. MERGED 06:52 CST Nov 14: #3399, main 48022d97f2d7, at 06:46 CST (runner 10, relayed; the link of #3399 to this step is the coordinator's 06:16 words). Done on merge. Not proven: that the next claude-settings PR that touches no macOS code skips the macOS jobs; reopen if one still runs them. SOURCE 06:56 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 06:50): the link of #3399 to this step is the lane's own hand-in at 05:00 CST, which the coordinator read; it replaces my earlier note that gave the coordinator's 06:16 word.
source: Owner ruling r61 b (15:29 CST Nov 12): "Run the draft Mac test only when the files touch Mac code." This step enacts it at job level. Owner ruling r63 (q2 a): the install.sh tests run on Linux and macOS, so a PR touching install.sh still starts shell-macos. Neighbours: ci-mac-once-per-batch (doing; its lane is archived after #3302; its leftover is #3005's lane, a narrow PR that drops BOTH the Windows run and the macOS run of check_unknown_reads_contract.py (step unknown-reads-lint-linux-only; coordinator 03:24 CST Nov 14, from the lane, head 013e6d573; unchecked by triage), a different PR), ci-batch-mac-runner, ci-macos-idle-measure, install-change-runs-install-jobs (done).
note: Triage 03:22 CST Nov 14: design (consultant): gate shell-macos, checks-macos and checks-macos-b at JOB level on `needs.scope.outputs`; all-jobs-passed accepts a job skipped because scope said no, and any other skip still fails. Red first: a PR touching no macOS path starts zero macOS runners and all-jobs-passed is green; a PR touching install.sh starts shell-macos. Coordinator's risks, in the brief: (a) it changes a SHARED guard's verdict (all-jobs-passed serves every repo): a guard or check change, round 3 rule, net-value test; (b) the action must tell "scope said no" from "scope itself failed or was skipped" (dependents then skip too, and must still fail); (c) it changes what a green rollup proves: one test per case. The lane lists the other jobs gated at step level only (Windows legs, checks-mutate, child repos' jobs) as follow-ups in its PR body. Tracker: the coordinator; path ALONE; draft first. Not started. Lane started 03:24 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:22, relayed): tracker the coordinator, path ALONE, draft first.
